scope: first Drain group-creation parser calls in the authentic first 50000 source rows
cut_justification: metadata-only feasibility: 60-percent prefix cut leaves only16 future calls; fixed first10000 permits531 past and99 future calls,88 new-to-origin; no correctness labels examined when choosing cut
initialization: 10 seeded uniformly sampled actual past calls, no synthetic initial examples
acquisition: original balanced Clotho, fit PCA using all past candidate covariates only; reveal labels only after selection; same100 reference IDs/order for every scorer
failure_label: at most2 exact GT matches among uncorrected samples[5:10], GT of first input; no AdaParser/group-majority targets
clotho_past: original seeded phase3 harness, adaptive PCA/KFold/k/entropy ridge restricted to past covariates and acquired past labels
clotho_future_covariates: same past reference order; original all630 PCA fitting is explicitly transductive, no future labels
lr: reference-only raw PCA16; full-reference whitening; balanced C1 tol1e-10 max_iter3000
shared: same reference-only PCA16 as LR; equal class covariance pooling; no class priors; ridge alpha times full-reference sample covariance
alpha_provenance: per-model median inherited Gaussian-complexity reference_support alpha, both splits/seeds, excluding Thunderbird entirely; frozen before current outcomes
novelty: GT absent from all first10000 raw rows; diagnostic only, never predictor input
earlier_holdout: unacquired past calls; their labels never used to fit or select; PCA for past Clotho can use their unlabeled covariates
statistics: mean/SD across5 reference seeds descriptive; paired4000 GT-template cluster bootstrap on fixed future calls retaining all seeds; conditional within one system, no system-population inference
acquisition_comparison: omitted: archived histories refer to shuffled benchmark, not chronological call IDs; no new policy search
no_fallback: undefined one-class metrics are null; no moving cut or replacing test population
resources: CPU only, threads1,4 processes; no new model generation/extraction;10 jobs plus deterministic rerun
interpretation: exploratory one-system prefix study; new-to-origin means first seen in supplied corpus, not proven global template creation; no causal novelty effect
